verdict: Getscreen.me: Choose Getscreen.me when remote access / screen share is the productivity job — adjacent to, not instead of, a work OS. Marked adjacent — not a work-OS / project-management peer for undifferentiated best-page ranking. Scores use the project-management editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.

Buyers evaluating adjacent productivity beside a separate work OS

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine project-management editorial criteria using the category weights (work planning 15, automation & workflows 14, ease of use 12, collaboration 12, integrations 12, reporting 10, value 10, scalability 9, AI 6), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — work OS / PM peers, timeline specialists, and adjacent PDF / remote-access / desktop-workspace tools are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking.
